associations.rationale: The formal type equips the quotient construction with a k-module structure, but it does not itself state the linear equivalence to the tensor product or the image of generator classes.
The formal type gives a k-linear equivalence from the quotient construction to the tensor product, but it does not itself state the quotient's module structure or the generator-class formula.

The formal equality states that the named equivalence sends each generator class to the corresponding pure tensor, but it does not itself display the module structure and linear-equivalence components of the complete claim.
